title: fix(web): hide the desktop rail on phones
body:
At phone widths the sidebar was hidden but the desktop rail was not, so the menu showed at the top of the page as well as in the bottom bar. One rule in the existing phone block hides the rail; the bottom nav is the only menu below 720px and page content starts at the top.

Verified: `bun run check`; web tests; the real app at 390px on the inbox, All open, Repositories and Settings with no sideways scroll, and the rail still shown at 1024px.

Refs CL-XXXX
author: TheGreatAxios
commits: fix(web): hide the desktop rail on phones
